summary: Bush-edged university car park bays with only non-residential buildings close.
reasons: Backs onto bush and tree canopy
Nearest buildings are university, not homes
Cars already park in the bays

best_section.where: angled bays at the bush edge, north-west end of the line

drivers.seclusion: Bays sit under dense trees; university buildings are 10 m or more away and the nearest homes are 39 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with angled bays open to the road; plenty of room to stop clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet campus lot off Discovery Drive.
drivers.convention: Cars are parked in the bays in both images; no signs shown, so campus rules are unknown.

flags: Steep: about 6% mean, up to 14% on the line
University car park; permit rules may apply
